_about: Shipped default config. Lobby and directory are pre-joined and pinned to their root keys; mail.hosts is the default mail host. Entries that still hold a REPLACE-ME placeholder are ignored, so until real values are filled in the client starts with an empty sidebar. A user config (srnet snapps --config FILE, or <home>/client.json) is layered on top: entries with the same id override these, {"id": "lobby", "disabled": true} drops one.
